info.name: Smithery connect API
info.description: Connect to MCP servers hosted on Smithery without managing OAuth, credentials, or sessions. Create stateless connections to any MCP server, execute MCP JSON-RPC, list/call tools and triggers, and manage subscriptions for trigger events.

request.description: List namespace-scoped trigger subscriptions for all connections in the namespace.
Create a namespace-scoped subscription that receives events from every connection in the namespace.
Get a specific trigger instance for a connection.
Delete a trigger instance and deregister its upstream webhook.
Get the schema for a single trigger type.
Create a trigger instance for a connection using the trigger's declared params.
List trigger types exposed by a connection.

response.name: Trigger definitions

request.description: List trigger subscriptions scoped to a single connection.
Create a connection-scoped subscription that receives events from one connection.

Create or update an MCP connection with the given ID. mcpUrl is required when creating a new connection, but optional when updating. Returns 409 if a different mcpUrl is provided, except while the connection is input_required and the new URL keeps the same host and path.

response.name: Namespace not found or access denied

request.description: Get details for a specific connection. Requires service token with connections:read scope.
Delete a connection and terminate its MCP session. Requires API key and namespace ownership.
Create a new MCP connection with an auto-generated ID. Requires API key and namespace ownership.
